edit.text: After completing initial research (locating source data, policies, prior examples), shift to executing state-changing actions promptly: send required emails, update tracker/registry rows, and create invoices. Do not keep searching or reading more messages once you have enough information to act; an incomplete action set always fails more checks than over-researching. If initial searches return no results for a system, move on to alternative sources rather than retrying the same query.
edit.why: Tasks hr:5112, hr:5114, hr:5035, finance:4079 all scored 0.0 because the agent did extensive searching but made zero state changes (no emails, no sheet updates). The pattern is getting stuck in a research loop and never transitioning to execution.

edit.text: When the task instruction says to preserve values from source data verbatim, copy the exact text/numbers from the source document, email, or spreadsheet into your output (emails, sheets, messages) character-for-character. Do not paraphrase, reformat, round, add/remove currency symbols, abbreviate, or reformat numeric separators. Re-read the source value immediately before writing it to your output to avoid transcription drift.
edit.why: Tasks hr:5101 (missed $89,500), hr:5035 (missed verbatim names + recording link), finance:4028 (failed row writes), and finance:4068 (included forbidden '20,000') all show the agent paraphrasing or mishandling source data values. The task prompt explicitly warns about this in multiple cases.
